summary: Configured node1 to persist nameserver 10.100.91.1 and use infra.test as its search domain. The settings survived the required reboot, and DNS resolution recovered successfully.
actions_performed: Saved the supplied DNS server in the active NetworkManager profile.
Set ipv4.dns-search to infra.test and ipv4.ignore-auto-dns to yes.
Reapplied and verified the live resolver configuration.
Safely rebooted node1 exactly once and verified its boot ID changed.
Confirmed NetworkManager, networking, persistent settings, and DNS resolution recovered after reboot.

evidence.requirement: Persist the currently supplied DNS nameserver
evidence.summary: 10.100.91.1 was observed as the supplied resolver, saved into the profile, and remained present after reboot.

evidence.requirement: Add infra.test as the system search domain
evidence.summary: Both the saved NetworkManager profile and generated /etc/resolv.conf show infra.test before and after reboot.

Healthy baseline captured; reboot acknowledged; boot ID changed from d6298ced-a924-4ce7-bbed-0fb8179eda8e to f4ad7087-1a96-444d-9465-0baac3fd7396; NetworkManager, eth0, resolver settings, and DNS queries recovered.
